title: Get detailed information for a parliamentary item ('Verhandlungsgegenstand') — get_item_details

Can absolute URL starting "https://www.parlament.gv./" relative path (without leading slashes). function normalize relative paths automatically. NULL none. introducers (list): Tibble columns role, name, frak_code, url persons introduced item. NULL unavailable. references (list): Tibble columns text, subject, zitation, url, art related parliamentary items. NULL none. topics (list): Character vector topic labels. headwords (list): Character vector headword labels. eurovoc (list): Character vector EuroVoc terms. votes (list): Vote information item page. votes[[1]] either NULL list fields result, infavor, code, text, comment. nested result field data frame columns text, code, color, fraction, infavor. Stage-level columns (inside stages): phase (character): phase legislative stage (e.g. "Ausschussbehandlung"). NA items flat stages (phase wrapper). stage_date (Date): date stage. stage_name (character): name/description stage (HTML stripped). stage_names (list): Stage-level names/introducer information, present. speeches (list): Nested tibble columns speaker, speaker_url, position, protocol_page, protocol_url, video_url. title: Get items under negotiation ('Verhandlungsgegenstände') — get_items
text: get_items searches items ('Verhandlungsgegenstände') subject negotiations Austrian National Council ('Nationalrat') Federal Council ('Bundesrat'). function mirrors search functionality offered Austrian Parliament's website (see ).

code: get_items(   topic = NULL,   institution = NULL,   legis_period = NULL,   date_start = NULL,   date_end = NULL,   item = NULL,   type_doc = NULL,   type_eu_submission = NULL,   person = NULL,   keyword = NULL,   eurovoc = NULL,   parl_group = NULL,   parl_group_names_standard = FALSE,   echo = TRUE )

title: Get items under negotiation ('Verhandlungsgegenstände') — get_items
text: topic (Thema) Character vector NULL. Specifies topic(s) search . See 'Details' possible values. Default NULL. institution Character string. Either "NR" "Nationalrat" (National Council), "BR" "Bundesrat" (Federal Council). Default NULL, returns chambers. combined person, filters parliamentary items; restrict person's institutional affiliations. legis_period Character numeric vector, NULL. Specifies legislative period(s) search . NULL (default), period restriction applied. See 'Details' possible values API result limit. date_start Character string. Start date search period format "dd-mm-yyyy", "dd.mm.yyyy", "dd/mm/yyyy". Default NULL. date_end Character string. End date search period format "dd-mm-yyyy", "dd.mm.yyyy", "dd/mm/yyyy". Default NULL. item (Gegenstand) Character vector NULL. Specifies type(s) parliamentary item(s) search . See 'Details' possible values. Default NULL. type_doc (Art des Antrages / Art der Anfrage) Character vector NULL. Specifies document type certain item types. Permissible values depend item institution. See 'Details' possible values. Default NULL. type_eu_submission (Art der EU-Vorlage) Character vector NULL. Type(s) EU submission search . Can specified item = "EU". See 'Details' possible values. Default NULL. person Character string NULL. Name person search (family name, optionally followed first name). People resolved across institutional categories item filters applied. Default NULL. keyword Character vector NULL. Keyword(s) search . Default NULL. eurovoc Character vector NULL. EuroVoc term(s) search . Default NULL. parl_group Character vector NULL. Parliamentary group(s) search . Default NULL. Combine multiple groups vector, .e. c("SPÖ", "ÖVP"). See Details. parl_group_names_standard Logical. TRUE, function expands standardizes parliamentary group names. Default FALSE. See Details. echo Logical. TRUE, function prints URL pertaining search results website Austrian Parliament number results.

title: Get items under negotiation ('Verhandlungsgegenstände') — get_items

title: Get items under negotiation ('Verhandlungsgegenstände') — get_items
text: Austrian Parliament API imposes maximum limit 100,000 rows per query. query reaches limit, function issues warning results may incomplete. Strategies handle large result sets: Refine search criteria (narrower date ranges, specific topics, individual legislative periods) Split queries multiple requests combine results using purrr::map() purrr::list_rbind() Example splitting legislative period:
code: library(purrr)  # Query items for multiple legislative periods separately periods <- c(25, 26, 27, 28) all_results <- periods %>%   map(\(period) get_items(legis_period = period, echo = FALSE)) %>%   list_rbind()

title: Get mandates — get_mandates
text: Takes one multiple names pad_interns input returns dataframe past present mandates. Mandates can limited specific date institution. Mandates cover memberships Parliament, also executive (e.g. Bundeskanzler/Chancellor). Note single row returned dataframe can represent e.g. multiple mandates e.g. Nationalrat consecutively held. function partly mimics behavior 'Personensuche' website Parliament ().

text: name character vector name(s). title: Get detailed information about Members of Parliament — get_mps_details
text: function retrieves details Members Parliament (MPs) three categories: speeches held plenary meetings ("plenary"), relevant activities ("activities"), participation committees ("committees"). Depending requested details category, different function parameters available. example data source website Austrian Parliament, see different tabs e.g., .

title: Get detailed information about Members of Parliament — get_mps_details
code: get_mps_details(   pad_intern,   detail_type,   institution = NULL,   legis_period = NULL,   item = NULL,   search_string = NULL,   committee = NULL,   committee_position = NULL,   echo = TRUE )

title: Get detailed information about Members of Parliament — get_mps_details
text: pad_intern ID MP. Vector length 1. See get_pad_intern() details. detail_type Character string specifying type details retrieve: "plenary", "activities", "committees". examples see :  plenary ; activities; committees. institution Character string specifying parliamentary house. Permissible inputs "NR" (Nationalrat/National Council), "BR" (Bundesrat/Federal Council ) NULL (returns results houses). Defaults NULL. legis_period Numeric character vector specifying one legislative periods (optional). Accepts numeric values (e.g., 27 c(26, 27)), Roman numerals (e.g., "XXVII"), historical abbreviations. Must >= 20 valid periods. Defaults NULL. item Character string specifying item type (Art des Verhandlungsgegenstandes) (optional). Defaults NULL. Used details category "activities". See Details . search_string Character string searching within activities (optional). Defaults NULL. Currently implemented details category "activities". committee Character string specifying committee name (optional). detail_type == "committees". See Details section valid committee names. committee_position Character string specifying committee position (optional). detail_type == "committees". Common values include "Mitglied", "Vorsitzende/r", "Stellvertretende/r Vorsitzende/r". echo Logical indicating whether print URL corresponding results Parliament website number results. Defaults TRUE.

title: Get detailed information about Members of Parliament — get_mps_details
text: data frame containing requested MP details. structure depends detail_type parameter: detail_type = "plenary": Returns speeches person specified house, regardless mandate time speech. example, querying plenary activities Doris Bures National Council return speeches MP, also President National Council Minister. Columns returned: pad_intern: Unique identifier MP name: Full name MP position_name: List mandates/positions held time speech date: Date speech legis_period: Legislative period (Roman numeral) institution: Chamber Parliament: "NR" (National Council) "BR" (Federal Council) speech_title: Title speech meeting_url: URL meeting details page meeting_name: Name parliamentary meeting speech_transcript_url: URL speech transcript speech_media_url: URL speech recordings, available detail_type = "activities": Returns parliamentary activities legislative items associated MP. Columns returned: pad_intern: Unique identifier MP legis_period: Legislative period institution: Chamber Parliament: "NR" (National Council) "BR" (Federal Council) frmdate: Date field ityp_komm: Item type comment item_number: Number parliamentary item item_type: Type parliamentary item (e.g., "", "JMIN") title: Title/subject item date_updated: Last update date item item_url: URL item details status_text: Current status description status_numeric: Numeric status code detail_type = "committees": Returns committee memberships participation. Columns returned: pad_intern: Unique identifier MP name: Full name MP legis_period: Legislative period committee_name: Name committee committee_position: Position committee (e.g., "Mitglied", "Vorsitzende/r") institution: Chamber Parliament: "NR" (National Council) "BR" (Federal Council) committee_position_start: Start date committee membership committee_position_end: End date committee membership (NA still active) committee_active: Logical indicating membership currently active committee_url: URL committee details Returns NULL invisibly data found given parameters.

title: Get Participation Data from Austrian Parliament — get_participation
text: function sends request Austrian Parliament's API retrieve participation data based provided filter criteria. performs input validation parameter constructs API request accordingly. Valid values topic: "Arbeit" (Labor) "Außenpolitik" (Foreign Policy) "Bildung" (Education) "Budget und Finanzen" (Budget Finance) "Europäische Union" (European Union) "Familie und Generationen" (Family Generations) "Frauen und Gleichbehandlung" (Women Equal Treatment) "Gesundheit und Ernährung" (Health Nutrition) "Information und Medien" (Information Media) "Inneres und Recht" (Interior Justice) "Innovation, Technologie und Forschung" (Innovation, Technology Research) "Klima, Umwelt und Energie" (Climate, Environment Energy) "Kultur" (Culture) "Land- und Forstwirtschaft" (Agriculture Forestry) "Landesverteidigung" (National Defense) "Parlament und Demokratie" (Parliament Democracy) "Soziales" (Social Affairs) "Sport" (Sports) "Verkehr und Infrastruktur" (Transport Infrastructure) "Wirtschaft" (Economy) Setting topic = NULL returns values topics listed . Valid values item: "RGES" (Gesetzesinitiativen / Legislative Initiatives) "" (Ministerialentwürfe / Ministerial Drafts) "BI" (Bürgerinitiativen / Citizens' Initiatives) "PET" (Petitionen / Petitions) "SN" (Stellungnahmen / Statements) Setting item = NULL returns values review types listed . Valid values initiative_type (item=="RGES"): "" (Gesetzesanträge von Abgeordneten / Legislative Motions Members) "BUA" (Gesetzesanträge von Ausschüssen / Legislative Motions Committees) "RV" (Regierungsvorlagen / Government Bills) Setting initiative_type = NULL returns values initiative types listed . Valid values statement_type (item=="SN"): "SNME" (Stellungnahme Ministerialentwurf / Statement Ministerial Draft) "SN" (Stellungnahme Gesetzesinitiative / Statement Legislative Initiative) "SPET" (Stellungnahme zur Petition / Statement Petition) "SPET-BR" (Stellungnahme zur Petition Bundesrat / Statement Petition Federal Council) "SBI" (Stellungnahme Bürgerinitiative / Statement Citizens' Initiative) Setting statement_type = NULL returns values statement types listed .

title: Get Data on Plenary Meetings of the Austrian Parliament — get_plenary_meetings
text: institution character string specifying institution. "BR" (Bundesrat/Federal Council), "NR" (Nationalrat/National Council), "BV" (Bundesversammlung/Federal Assembly). legis_period Numeric value vector specifying legislative period(s). Explicit filters supported 20th period onwards. NULL retrieves available periods, including periods 20th historical codes "KN" "PN". must NULL institution = "BV" Bundesversammlung use legislative periods. meeting_and_activities character string. One 'meetings' 'activities'. 'meetings' returns plenary meeting entries; 'activities' returns parliamentary items submitted acted upon meetings. applicable institution "BV" (Bundesversammlung); must NULL BV institution. session_type character string vector. Filter meeting period type. Permissible values: "N" (Ordentliche Tagung / Ordinary session), "" (Ausserordentliche Tagung / Extraordinary session). Can NULL retrieve meeting period types. applicable institution "BV". meeting_type character string vector. Filter sitting type. Permissible values: "S" (Sitzung / Regular sitting), "" (Sondersitzung / Special sitting), "ZU" (Zuweisungssitzung / Assignment sitting), "N" (Nachtrag / Addendum). Can NULL retrieve sitting types. applicable meeting_and_activities = "meetings". echo Logical. TRUE, prints URL corresponding search Parliament website, pagination progress, number results. Default FALSE.

title: Retrieve Transcripts from the Austrian Parliament API — get_transcripts
text: search_string Optional character string filter transcripts keywords. Defaults NULL. legis_period Legislative period(s). NULL (default) queries available legislative periods. Accepts numeric (10), character ("10"), Roman numerals ("X"), well "KN" (Konstituierende Nationalversammlung) "PN" (Provisorische Nationalversammlung). meeting_type Optional character string specifying type(s) meeting. Permissible values "NRSITZ" (National Council - Plenary meetings) "BRSITZ" (Federal Council - Plenary meetings). Defaults NULL, queries NRSITZ BRSITZ. See Details information. date_start Optional start date filtering transcripts. Defaults NULL. Date dmy-format (e.g. "01.05.2020", "01/05/2020", "01-05-2020", "01052020"). date_end Optional end date filtering transcripts. Defaults NULL. Date dmy-format (e.g. "01.05.2020", "01/05/2020", "01-05-2020", "01052020"). echo Logical. TRUE, function prints URL corresponding search results website Austrian Parliament number results. Default TRUE. export Optional character string enable PDF downloads. Set "pdf" download transcript PDFs. Defaults NULL (export). export_destination Character string specifying directory path PDFs saved. Defaults "transcripts" (folder current working directory). folder exist, user prompted create interactive meetings.
